Having two cats means there is always hair somewhere on the furniture, and I have gone through quite a few different cleaning tools over the years. This glove is one of the easiest solutions I have found. You simply run your hand over the fabric, and the hair gathers together where it can be removed very easily.

I especially prefer it to adhesive rollers. They work for a short time, but the sheets fill with hair quickly and you constantly need replacements. I have also tried reusable brushes with built-in collection compartments, but those add another part that needs to be emptied and cleaned. This glove is much simpler: collect the hair, pull it off, and keep going.

After around a month of use, I did notice the edges beginning to curve upward a little, so the entire surface no longer lies completely flat against the furniture. It is a minor drawback, but in practice it has not stopped the glove from working well. With two cats, anything that makes regular furniture cleanup this quick and easy gets a lot of use in my home.

Helpful for Pet Hair, but Not as Effective as Expected

These pet hair removal gloves are a convenient reusable option for cleaning dog and cat hair from furniture, clothing, carpets, car seats, and pet beds. The two-pack is useful, and the mitt-style design makes it easy to quickly run your hand over larger surfaces.

They do pick up loose pet hair reasonably well, particularly on couches and other fabric surfaces. However, I found that more embedded or stubborn hair often required several passes, and the results weren't quite as effective as I had hoped.

The gloves are comfortable to wear and the dual-sided design is convenient for cleaning different surfaces. They're also reusable, which is a nice alternative to constantly going through disposable lint roller sheets.

The main drawback is that removing all of the collected hair from the gloves can be a little frustrating, and they don't always grab every strand on the first pass. They work for quick cleanups, but I still find myself reaching for other pet hair removal tools when I need a more thorough clean.

Overall, these gloves are useful to have around for everyday pet hair cleanup, but the performance is fairly average. They work best for loose surface hair rather than deeply embedded fur.
